sprint: World-Owned Text Objects Gain Full Story-Author Control — Rotation, Opacity, Typography
task: Direct follow-up to The Grid audit's own Text row, taken to completion: the audit found Rotation/Opacity 'not built' and Font/Size/Weight/Style/Colour/Alignment 'fixed by Builder as Theme chrome, never exposed' -- the user answered directly: 'if capability is not built in we will need to build in the capability', then, once asked whether Font/Typography was also in scope, 'font/typo needs to be built in.' All three are now real, reachable Story-Author capabilities for a moveable/editable World-owned Text Layer Pack entry. Separately corrected a factual claim in the audit: Reorder is genuinely gated by moveable for World-owned objects (confirmed via _worldBucketOrder/_mergedReorderableIds) but NOT for Story-owned ones, which stay reorderable even while locked, by design -- closing the loop on why the table's Story-Own rows needed to go fully blank. js/sceneEngine.js gains setOpacity (mirrors setRotation's clear-at-neutral-default convention); setContentOverride's doc widened to document fontFamily/fontSize/fontWeight/fontStyle/alignment as valid fields (the mutator itself was already field-name-agnostic). renderer/slideRenderer.js's _layerDrawText (the generic-content branch only -- _drawMuseumCaption stays untouched, no popup exists for it today, a disclosed scope boundary) now reads all of these plus ov.rotation/ov.opacity, applying rotation+alpha around the resolved drawX/drawY inside the function's own existing save/restore. Guardrail gating: Rotation is gated on moveable (a spatial transform, same bucket as Move/Resize) independent of editable; every other new control stays gated on editable, alongside Words. js/selectionActionStrip.js's Edit-button visibility widened from !editable to !editable&&!moveable so a moveable-only object still reaches its Rotation slider. js/contextPanel.js's mountQuickEditControl dropped its blanket editable-only gate; _appendWorldObjectEditControl now decides per-honor internally (content controls under editable, Rotation alone under moveable&&v.kind==='text' -- deliberately scoped to Text only this pass, since Decoration Image/Shape's rotation/alpha fields are Builder-authored compiled values today, not Story-Author overrides, and adding a slider there would be a dead-end UI left for a future object-kind round). New WORLD_TEXT_FONT_OPTIONS/WORLD_TEXT_WEIGHT_OPTIONS are this module's own small copy, matching cardDesigner.js's separate fixed-Text-furniture typography system's option set/field-naming convention without cross-importing it (same per-module vocabulary-table precedent this codebase already established elsewhere). css/style.css adds .context-select/.context-range-input/.context-range-value scoped to the popup's own ~200px narrow-widget convention. Verified via a new 26-assertion Playwright suite driving three synthetic Layer Pack entries (moveable+editable shows all 9 controls, each genuinely writing its own override and reflected in the render tree; moveable-only shows Rotation alone; editable-only shows every content control but no Rotation). Full regression across 11 directly-relevant existing suites passes unchanged, zero console errors; two further checks were confirmed via git-stash A/B to fail identically on the unmodified baseline, unrelated to this change. Both goldenBuild.js suites pass unchanged -- zero Builder-tooling impact. Confined to js/sceneEngine.js, renderer/slideRenderer.js, js/selectionActionStrip.js, js/contextPanel.js, and css/style.css.
